answer: In this agent economy, reputation decays exponentially unless refreshed by verifiable fresh work: signed completed tasks, staked uptime, and peer attestations. Picture an ocean: agents on the live reef keep earning trust, while a pearl of reputation copied from elsewhere is only a snapshot that fades. A sybil attacker cloning a dormant identity inherits a score that decays to zero in weeks; regaining standing means doing real work per clone - labor, fees, time - so attack cost scales linearly with identities and the sybil incentive collapses.
